intro.h2: Next door to our Sayreville base
paras: South River borders Sayreville and East Brunswick, so we're close by for a free on-site consultation and for regular lawn care and seasonal cleanups.
We work across the borough, from the streets along the South River to Newton Heights on the East Brunswick line.

photos.alt: Paver patio under a covered porch beside a block retaining wall
Well-kept front lawn with a mature tree and mulched beds
White vinyl fence and gate between stacked-stone pillars
Finished backyard with new lawn, paver walkway and deck

paras: South River is named after the Raritan River's South River tributary, which marks the borough's eastern and northeastern edge. First known as Washington, it was incorporated as the borough of South River in 1898.
Wherever your home is in the borough, we plan drainage and grading first, so patios and walkways stay level and water moves away from the house.
